content: Intel’s operating loss for 2025 was **$10.3 billion**【Doc 1: INTC 10-K 0000050863-26-000011】. This figure is also reflected in the consolidated financial statements, where the operating loss for the year ended December 27, 2025 is reported as **$(10,318) million**【Doc 2: INTC 10-K 0000050863-26-000011】.
